sources.entry: Cleaner for Xcode - Cleaner for Xcode.app built with react-native-macOS.

summary.one_liner: A macOS app built with react-native-macOS that cleans out leftover and deprecated files from Xcode to free disk space.
summary.what_it_does: The app is described as removing unwanted and deprecated files so Xcode runs faster and more disk space is freed. The README suggests running it weekly or monthly to keep the developer folder tidy. A newer SwiftUI version is mentioned at the top of the README, but no details about it are given. It is available on the Mac App Store, and the README also explains how to build it from source using npm or yarn and an Xcode project. The README is written in English with a Chinese translation of the main description.
use_cases: free up disk space used by Xcode
speed up Xcode by clearing leftovers
how_to_run: Install latest node, npm or yarn, and watchman (e.g. via homebrew)
Run `npm install` or `yarn` in the project directory
Run `open macos/XcodeCleaner.xcodeproj` to open the Xcode project
Disable App Sandbox in the target's Capabilities
notable: Removes leftover and deprecated Xcode files to free disk space
Available on the Mac App Store
Newer SwiftUI version announced in the README
Build instructions for running from source in Xcode
caveats: Building from source requires disabling App Sandbox
Build downloads from npmjs.com, github and sourceforge may be slow or need a global proxy for some users (noted in FAQ)
